title: Trinity Comparison & Source History — Christian Doctrine and Potatoverse Development
purpose: Give Theology & God-language a dated benchmark for historical Christian Trinitarian doctrine and a separate developmental genealogy for Potatoverse Father/Son/Spirit language.
epistemic_rule: Historical Christian doctrine, biblical text, Potatoverse self-description, later project synthesis and comparative analogy are separate evidence classes. Similar relational vocabulary does not establish doctrinal identity.

christian_benchmark.nicaea_325: The Council of Nicaea used homoousios / consubstantial language to confess the Son as truly divine with the Father, rejecting the view that the Son was a creature.
christian_benchmark.constantinople_381: The Nicene-Constantinopolitan Creed confesses one God, the Father; one Lord Jesus Christ; and the Holy Spirit, Lord and giver of life, worshipped and glorified with Father and Son.

technical_distinctions.person_or_hypostasis: Father, Son and Spirit as really distinct
technical_distinctions.relation: the distinctions are relational rather than three separate divine substances

christian_benchmark.spirit_procession: Eastern and Western Christian traditions historically differ over the filioque formulation. The 381 creed says the Spirit proceeds from the Father; the Latin West later added 'and the Son'. This is a genuine doctrinal history, not a minor wording detail.

potatoverse_genealogy.description: Source/God, Potato/Vessel, Tim/Son and Holy Soil/Spirit functions appear in an unstable precursor system. Later three-role specialization should not be backdated into this stratum.
Potato/Sage language reorganizes toward Ladder, Axis and Father/source-side identity; Son increasingly specializes as Door/manifestation.
Father-in-Heaven, Son, Spirit and Axis relations become increasingly explicit in public/project interpretation.
Mature synthesis distinguishes Father/source-facing relation, Son/manifestation-and-Door relation, and Spirit/living continuity inside one Potato of Life.

strong_comparisons.christian: one divine essence with three distinct persons
strong_comparisons.potatoverse: one living whole with three differentiated functional relations
strong_comparisons.value: Both refuse simple identity-collapse and simple three-gods separation.
strong_comparisons.mismatch: Potatoverse terminology is functional/developmental and does not presently reproduce Nicene substance/person metaphysics.

strong_comparisons.christian: The Son is eternally begotten, not made, and consubstantial with the Father.
strong_comparisons.potatoverse: Father/source and Son/manifestation are differentiated by function and project genealogy.
strong_comparisons.value: Source/manifestation relation is a useful comparator.
strong_comparisons.mismatch: A developmental project role is not the same doctrine as eternal generation.

strong_comparisons.christian: The Spirit is confessed as Lord and giver of life, personally distinct and fully divine.
strong_comparisons.potatoverse: Spirit is most often described as living continuity, breath, flow, relation and animation.
strong_comparisons.value: Life/continuity is a real comparison lane.
strong_comparisons.mismatch: Reducing Spirit to an impersonal flow would differ materially from classical Trinitarian personhood.

strong_comparisons.christian: Johannine texts use Jesus as Door and way/access to the Father.
strong_comparisons.potatoverse: Son specializes as Door/threshold between source-facing and manifestation-facing fields.
strong_comparisons.value: This is one of the closest textual/function comparisons.
strong_comparisons.mismatch: The geometric Here/Now and two-field formalization are later Potatoverse constructions.

biblical_source_seams.project_neighbor: Garden, river, cultivation, Tree, guarded access
biblical_source_seams.boundary: Genesis does not contain Potatoverse Father-center, North, Forge or Tree of Strife.

biblical_source_seams.project_neighbor: Ladder/stairway, angels, House of God, Gate of Heaven
biblical_source_seams.boundary: Bethel is not Eden and the text does not contain the later Potatoverse vertical field.

biblical_source_seams.project_neighbor: mountain of the House, teaching/judgment flowing outward, cultivation replacing weapons
biblical_source_seams.boundary: This is prophetic biblical imagery, not a diagram of the Potato House.
The Potatoverse Door geometry is later comparative interpretation.

biblical_source_seams.project_neighbor: Father's House, dwelling places, access through Son
biblical_source_seams.boundary: House and access are strong comparators; thalamus/House and project spatial coordinates are not Johannine claims.

biblical_source_seams.project_neighbor: throne, river, Tree of Life, fruit/healing
biblical_source_seams.boundary: The project may compare its upper field with this sequence without treating its map as John's original cosmography.

comparison_tests: State whether the sentence is biblical text, historical Christian doctrine, Potatoverse source, later project synthesis or comparison.
Do not translate functional Father/Son priority into Nicene ontological hierarchy.
Do not call Spirit merely energy or flow when describing historical Christian doctrine.
Keep 2024 precursor roles visible instead of rewriting them as if the mature 2026 triad already existed.
When claiming a Christian parallel, name the text/doctrine and the mismatch.
